verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment isolated from production data is a fair axis for an FP&A SaaS platform, but the evidence never documents one. The self-serve interactive demo is a product walkthrough, and the base/bull/bear scenario versions are a related planning feature, not an isolated test environment. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
